query: SELECT id AS "id!: String", json_quote(json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.fact.guard')) AS "guard!: String", json_quote(json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.fact.evaluator.actor.actor')) AS "actor!: String", json_quote(json_extract(payload, '$.record.envelope.position')) AS "position!: String" FROM record_identities WHERE kind = 'fact' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.kind') = 'evaluatorResult' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.fact.subject.kind') = 'project' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.fact.subject.id') = ?
